value_flows.description: Harvest: operator claims staking rewards, updates total assets

Redelegation: operator moves ETH between validators
Withdrawal request: user burns LRT tokens, queues withdrawal
value_flows.path: User requestWithdrawal() -> burn LRT -> queue withdrawal request

value_flows.description: Finalization: operator finalizes withdrawal epoch, distributes RON
value_flows.path: LiquidRon.finaliseRonRewardsForEpoch() -> withdraw from vault -> distribute to pending

value_flows.description: Redeem: user receives RON for finalized withdrawal
value_flows.path: User redeem() -> transfer RON from escrow -> delete request

value_flows.operation: deposit() payable: User sends native RON, contract wraps to WRON, deposits to escrow, mints LRON shares
value_flows.order: 1. Receive native RON, 2. Wrap to WRON, 3. Transfer to escrow, 4. Deposit in escrow, 5. Mint shares to user

value_flows.operation: deposit(assets): User deposits WRON, contract mints LRON shares
value_flows.order: 1. Transfer WRON from user, 2. Mint shares to receiver

value_flows.operation: mint(assets): User mints LRON by providing WRON
value_flows.order: 1. Calculate shares needed, 2. Transfer WRON from user, 3. Mint shares to receiver

value_flows.operation: withdraw(assets): User withdraws WRON, contract burns LRON and sends native RON
value_flows.order: 1. Burn shares, 2. Transfer WRON to contract, 3. Unwrap to native RON, 4. Send to receiver

value_flows.operation: redeem(shares): User redeems LRON for native RON
value_flows.order: 1. Calculate assets, 2. Burn shares, 3. Transfer WRON to contract, 4. Unwrap to native RON, 5. Send to receiver

value_flows.operation: requestWithdrawal: User locks LRON shares for future withdrawal
value_flows.order: 1. Transfer shares to contract, 2. Lock shares for epoch

value_flows.operation: redeem(epoch): User claims assets from escrow for finalized epoch
value_flows.order: 1. Verify epoch finalized, 2. Calculate assets from locked price, 3. Transfer from escrow to contract, 4. Unwrap to native RON, 5. Send to user

value_flows.operation: finaliseRonRewardsForEpoch: Operator finalizes epoch by moving assets to escrow
value_flows.order: 1. Lock price per share, 2. Calculate assets, 3. Withdraw from vault to escrow, 4. Update status

value_flows.operation: delegateAmount: Operator moves WRON from vault to proxy for staking
value_flows.order: 1. Calculate total amount, 2. Withdraw WRON to proxy, 3. Delegate in proxy

value_flows.operation: harvest: Operator harvests rewards from proxy
value_flows.order: 1. Call proxy.harvest(), 2. Calculate fee, 3. Add to operatorFeeAmount

value_flows.operation: fetchOperatorFee: Fee recipient withdraws operator fees
value_flows.order: 1. Verify caller is feeRecipient, 2. Reset operatorFeeAmount, 3. Withdraw native RON to feeRecipient

value_flows.description: RON tokens (native ether) enter LiquidProxy via delegateAmount, harvest, undelegateAmount, or receive
value_flows.order: 1. External call with ether (delegateAmount or receive) or internal state change (harvest, undelegateAmount)

value_flows.description: RON tokens are delegated to roninStaking via delegateAmount
value_flows.order: 2. After receiving ether, call roninStaking.delegate with value

value_flows.description: RON tokens are claimed from roninStaking via harvest or harvestAndDelegateRewards
value_flows.order: 3. External call to roninStaking.claimRewards or delegateRewards, then ether is sent to vault via _depositRONTo

value_flows.description: RON tokens are undelegated from roninStaking via undelegateAmount, then sent to vault
ERC20 WRON tokens are minted on deposit and burned on withdraw in WrappedRon
value_flows.order: 1. deposit: msg.value received, _mint(msg.sender, msg.value). 2. withdraw: _burn(msg.sender, _amount), then ether sent to msg.sender

value_flows.description: ERC20 WRON tokens are approved in Escrow constructor to vault
value_flows.order: Constructor: approve vault for max uint256, enabling vault to spend tokens
